scope: Quality gate decisions recorded by the project art workflow. Applies to selected normalized runtime artwork and actual Godot previews. Rejected/raw trial sources are not silently accepted.

Approved identity concept boards, source atlases, revised librarian two-pose artwork and revised stamp four-wheel artwork
All five nine-pose contact sheets; actual cast and attack Godot captures at release in three resolutions
All 35 GIFs decoded/timing checked, seven-actions-runtime.jpg, five-cast-release.jpg, librarian-attack-samples.jpg
Alpha/isotropic scaling/no-clipping/idle reconstruction checks and current contract-check.log
